name: Behind You(Beta)
summary:
Behind You

A VR Horror Experience Made to make your adrenaline go through the roof

You’re trapped in a massive, pitch-black labyrinth — no map, no weapons, no safety. Just the echo of your own footsteps… and the thing that’s hunting you.

The creature is fast — faster than you think. It wanders the maze in silence until it sees you. When it does, you’ll hear the sudden shift — the roar, the footsteps pounding toward you — and then you run. You won’t get much time to react. Most don’t make it.
